units.text: IDEA: Replace the marginal overlap check with a send-vs-hold propensity model and report only holds with propensity within the support of sends. Require a minimum count of sends in the neighborhood, and report the share of holds dropped.

IDEA: Add a pre-registered decision chart: P(safe) bands by hit location, hit type, outs, and runner speed tercile, with the break-even p* for each cell, so a coach gets a usable lookup instead of a season-level runs total.

IDEA: Use a negative-control check. Apply the same flagging procedure to a placebo where the label is shuffled within game-season strata, or to sends only (cross-fitted), and require the real runs-left estimate to exceed the placebo distribution.

IDEA: Make the 30-out-at-home early stop a count-based rule on the 2025 data with explicit fallback, and add a minimum failures-per-covariate rule (for example, events-per-variable) so the logistic model is not fit on near-zero failures. If unmet, penalize the model or reduce covariates.

IDEA: Define label precedence explicitly. Order by final outcome: out at home, then scored in the same segment as the batted-ball play (SEND), then stopped at third (HOLD), with "advanced later" as its own excluded class in the primary analysis.

IDEA: Put the first-segment base rule, exclusions, 0.05 margin, and the label precedence into the frozen hash before the full 2025 data is opened, and reconcile the controller recount before the full pull.

IDEA: Freeze one mutually exclusive label hierarchy (coach-held, sent-safe, sent-out, ambiguous-advanced-later) and the base-at-contact definition before retrieval. Resolve the controller-versus-report discrepancy on the cached sample first, and make ambiguous runners a third class instead of folding them into SEND.

IDEA: Replace the stop rule with a precomputed power rule. Require a minimum number of out-at-home events in the pooled 2025 and 2026 data, and state in advance that a likely outcome is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Report the observed out rate with an exact upper bound.

IDEA: Make the positive criterion falsifiable by refitting the model inside each bootstrap, replacing the 0.05 margin with a pre-set value tested on the held-out data, and adding a negative control (for example, applying the flag rule to sends and checking if realized outcomes match predicted success).
IDEA: Use a joint overlap measure and decision-time covariates (prior-season speed and arm values) so the model does not use the same-season information.
